g.title: j3334011245
g.text: He says that he has told you the whole of it now, oui ? It nearly brings me to tears just to think of it...

g.title: j840654869
g.text: He says that he has told you some of it now, oui ? I am glad he has begun to open up to you...

g.title: j3878099964
g.text: I think he's okay, really. It's just... what he's been through - it's a lot.

g.title: j3411889463
g.text: It broke my heart... I just wish there was more I could do to help him...

g.title: j3505239869
g.text: I'm just glad he... finally trusted me enough to tell me his whole story...

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j3814136705
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1968848648
g.text: You do so much just by listening. For being there when he feels able to speak. He is not broken - the cracks in him do not run so deep as to threaten the foundation. They are scars that are shallow.

g.title: j1725503977

g.title: j3590788360
g.text: Oui, you understand. He is not some broken, empty thing. The cracks in him do not threaten the foundation. They are scars that are shallow.

g.title: j3327801774
g.text: Do you know, that yesterday, I found him sitting and reading a book of ancient philosophy to M'sieur Fibonacci ?

g.title: j3874678410
g.text: Oui. You do so much by listening. He is not some broken, empty thing. The cracks in him do not threaten the foundation. They are scars that are shallow.

g.title: j84783129
g.text: M'sieur Fibonacci had been begging for someone to read it to him for ages, but everyone else refused ! Did not want to give him des munitions, ha !

g.title: j2486207884

g.title: j2917093272
g.text: Our sweet Lyon never would have dreamed of doing such a thing. Talking to others in such a way. He was enjoying himself.

g.title: j3400473124
g.text: And I know it is not either of the Luminaries that I have to thank at evening prayer for that. It is you.

g.title: j3978371031
g.text: Oui ! And it is simply more proof that we are where we are meant to be. Here. With you. In this Sanctum. And together.

g.title: j3085064166
g.text: It... makes me reconsider my decision to work with you on mending the efforts between Monsieur Loid and the family above.

g.title: j731383733
g.text: It makes me realize how much of a tragédie it is that the devil refuses to aid our efforts in rebuilding the bridge between Monsieur Loid and the family above... I wonder if there is not something to be done about it.

g.title: j3844703164->j731383733

g.title: j2714175501
g.text: It makes me all the more eager to mend the bridge between Monsieur Loid and the family above ! Let us to work and be quick about it !

g.title: j2625162105
g.text: I... really didn't think I could get you to help.

g.title: j2197101167
g.text: Really? You're changing your mind about that?

g.title: j1527593087
g.text: Are you sure you want to take him on over that?

g.title: j1695425235
g.text: Really? You'd argue with Roathe on my behalf?

g.title: j1762570339
g.text: For all that you have done to help the brother of my soul ? While we may not agree on other matters - and may never see eye-to-eye, this ? This I shall do for you.

g.title: j2030488455
g.text: Ha ! I have fought with the devil over far less. And for all you have done to help the brother of my soul ? I would do it with joie.

g.title: j1456463622
g.text: The devil does not know his match. Watch how I destroy his will beneath my own. Marie sera victorieuse !

g.title: j989077985
